mason: MASON mutable network and simulation schedule source

Internal edge bags and direction conventions require custody and stable identity.

Same-time updates are sequential;lower ordering first and ties randomly ordered;new same-time event advances epsilon.
Selected scheduler shuffles equal-order substeps then invokes steps sequentially.
Seed setter narrows to32bits;start primes generator and resets schedule.
Checkpoint stream serializes state;file wrappers convert exceptions to null;restore invokes wake hook.

No synchronization on the model data

repast: Repast Simphony network, schedule and random registry source
BSD-style core conditions plus component-specific third-party licenses;not blanket clearance.
Network builder selects directed/undirected implementation before optional loading/generation.
Generic adjacency unions incoming/outgoing neighbors and deduplicates;in-edge accessor remains available.

Undirected network retains multigraph representation;degree convention counts incident edges.
Edge stores mutable weight with default1;exposure units remain caller contract.

setSeed invalidates defaults;reset also clears named distributions/generators and recreates clock-seeded default.
